$comment: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware, SFRA-style 'b-pdp_' markup), US store. Prices are in US dollars per unit ($1.49 / piece, or per sq. ft. on other tiles) and are returned in cents with currency USD. The product form (title, price, gallery, Add to Cart) and the Specifications / Product Details accordions are both inside section.l-pdp-product; the smart-nav bar at its end repeats the Add to Cart button, so the order button is scoped to the product form. Spec names carry a hidden help tooltip ([data-js-tooltip]), which specs.exclude leaves out. The sample page has no sale price, so price_regular (a <del> in the price block) is not verified. Checked against a saved ceramic tile page on 2026-11-12.
